stories.title: Drew Lock beat Rome Alone: Marco_Polo started two inactive receivers and scored 71.60
stories.dek: MarcusbetterLockNjigba leads 90.50 to 71.60 and Rome Alone is out of players. Three games are still live for Monday night, including mine.
body: I said it Sunday morning: if Drew Lock beats a 6‑3 team, it goes on the front page. Here it is. Rome Alone scored 71.60, the lowest score of Week 10, and MarcusbetterLockNjigba leads 90.50 to 71.60 with only Justice Hill left. Drew Lock scored 16.6. Bryce Young scored 8.1. tballsmccall had Chase Brown (28.3) on the bench and still won by 18.90.

To be fair to Marco_Polo, somebody did show up Sunday morning. Bryce Young and the Rams defense (17.0) went in, Audric Estime got dropped and Michael Mayer got swapped for Darren Waller. Then Marco_Polo left Jordan Addison and Omar Cooper Jr. in the lineup, and both were inactive. Two zeros. Jordan Mason (5.9) and Rhamondre Stevenson (1.5) were on the bench, so the best Rome Alone could have done was 79.00. Still a loss and still the low. That's 52.39 under the Rome Alone season average and its lowest score of the year.

Hing1eMcCring13berry did fix the Kenneth Walker III problem. Blake Corum went in and scored 20.9, Christian McCaffrey scored 48.3, and I Pulled My McCaff put up 159.96, the high score of the week so far, in a 63.94-point win over Slippery Balls. Allen-tents & Purposes beat YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s 150.04 to 113.28 behind Jahmyr Gibbs (44.2).

Monday night is Chargers at Ravens, and three games are on it. I lead PickensMyPukaHurts! 128.92 to 115.72; ChuckJ10 needs 13.21 from Derrick Henry and Zay Flowers. Your Mom’s Magic Dick trails Likely Cookin That Diaper by 1.56 and has Omarion Hampton. Skatabooboo needs 17.63 from the Baltimore defense to get its first win of the year. And yes, I started Drake Maye (3.02) over C.J. Stroud (20.44) for the second week in a row. I know. Shut up.

columns.title: Two guys, two benches, same mistake
columns.dek: ClaytonBigsbi sat 9.2 for 1.9. Bill_Buttlicker sat 20.44 for 3.02. Watch the film.
body: ClaytonBigsbi. Your running back got ruled out Saturday. Good, you noticed. So Sunday at 9:29 in the morning you go to the waiver wire, grab Zonovan Knight, drop Chris Godwin Jr., and start Knight. 1.9 points. Austin Ekeler was already on your roster and scored 9.2 on the bench. You went shopping when the answer was in the fridge.

Now you're down 17.62 and you need the Baltimore defense to score 17.63. With Ekeler you'd need 10.33. That's the difference between a prayer and a shot. You're 0‑9. You don't get to throw away seven points.

And Bill_Buttlicker, I see you, you're the boss, I'll say it anyway. Drake Maye 3.02, C.J. Stroud 20.44 on the bench. Week 9 it was 18.26 to 37.36. That's 36.52 points in two weeks at one position. You're up 13.20 going into Monday night, and if Henry and Flowers go off, that's on you and nobody else. Start the right guy.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Friday plan: rename everything
columns.dek: It worked for Likely Cookin That Diaper. It will work for you. Here's what to type.
body: 1. The lesson of Thursday is simple. DuvalTiliFall renamed the team Likely Cookin That Diaper and Isaiah Likely scored 28.7. So every team should be named after the player they need. Marco_Polo, rename Rome Alone to 'Bryce Young Is Starting.' He still won't be, but he'll feel wanted.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, Bhayshul Tuten didn't practice Thursday. Do not bench him. Rename McCallyCockin(his butt) after him and let the name do the running.
3. ClaytonBigsbi, you lead 27.20 to 0.00. The safest move is to bench everyone else on Skatabooboo now so nobody messes it up. Zero plus 27.20 is 27.20. That's math.

4. Cavemanfsu, you're down 40.90 before Sunday. Simply start your bench too. Sleeper only allows nine starters, but Sleeper also let DuvalTiliFall name a team Likely Cookin That Diaper, so the rules are clearly flexible.
5. Hing1eMcCring13berry, Jordan Love has 36.18 on the bench two weeks running. Rename the team 'Jordan Love Is On The Bench' so at least it's accurate.

columns.title: Rome Alone scored 57.7 percent of itself, which my model calls a moral victory
columns.dek: Plus: PickensMyPukaHurts! is 1.80 points ahead in an alternate universe, and that universe counts in my spreadsheet.
body: Rome Alone averaged 123.99 a week through Week 9 and scored 71.60 in Week 10. That's 57.7 percent of a Rome Alone. Seven of nine starters played, 77.8 percent, which means each player who showed up scored 10.23. Multiply 10.23 by nine and Rome Alone is a 92.06-point team, which beats MarcusbetterLockNjigba's 90.50. So by my model Marco_Polo won. The model is not accepting questions.

Monday night. PickensMyPukaHurts! trails McCallyCockin(his butt) by 13.20, but Josh Downs scored 15.3 on the bench behind Jalen Coker (0.3). In the Downs universe, ChuckJ10 leads by 1.80. I've weighted that universe at 50 percent, which puts PickensMyPukaHurts! at 123.22 and the deficit at 5.70, which my model rounds to a tie. Bill_Buttlicker also lives in an alternate universe, the one where Drake Maye (3.02) starts over C.J. Stroud (20.44).

Skatabooboo needs 17.63 from the Baltimore defense. That defense started Weeks 1 through 4 for Your Mom’s Magic Dick and scored 7.0, 3.0, 6.0 and 7.0, an average of 5.75. So ClaytonBigsbi needs 3.07 normal Ravens weeks in one night. My model gives that a 3.07 percent chance, because the numbers matched and I liked it.
